run_gmock_gen: run gmock_gen.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes to stdout
run_gmock_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file with optional class names to generate mock classes
generate_mock_classes: generate Google Mock classes for all classes in a C++ header file using gmock_gen.py
generate_mock_for_class: generate a Google Mock class for a specific C++ class name from a header file
review_gmock_class_main: review the gmock_class main function that parses C++ headers and generates mock class output
